siteDescription: Tanvir Ahassan is a UI/UX designer with a software engineering background, creating clear, buildable web and mobile products with systems thinking and AI-assisted workflows.
heroHeadline: I turn complex requirements into products people understand—and teams can build.
heroSupporting: I’m Tanvir, a UI/UX designer with a software engineering background. I use systems thinking—and AI where it genuinely saves time—to move from an unclear brief to a thoughtful, shippable experience.
